messages.name: [A01] Admit
messages.description: Admit patient to unit/room via HL7 MLLP

messages.name: [A03] Discharge
messages.description: Discharge patient using saved admit state via HL7 MLLP

messages.name: [A02] Transfer
messages.description: Transfer patient to new location; prior location from saved admit state

messages.name: [A09] In Transit
messages.description: Patient in transit to new location; uses saved admit state

messages.name: [A10] Back In Room
messages.description: Patient back in room; uses saved admit state

messages.name: [A08] Update
messages.description: Update patient information; requires --patient and saved admit state

messages.name: [DISCH] Discharge Order
messages.description: ORM discharge task order; uses saved admit state

messages.name: [DISCH] Cancel Discharge Order
messages.description: Cancel ORM discharge task order; uses saved order ID from discharge-order
